canonical_name: The Artist's Way (12-week course at Still Point Wellness)
summary: A paid 12-week creativity course based on Julia Cameron's 'The Artist's Way' book, run as a commercial continuing-education offering by Still Point Wellness Float and Massage Spa in Asheville, facilitated by two named instructors (Robin Fann-Costanzo and Samata DeCori). It is capped at 10 students, costs $525 plus supplies, and enrollment is by signing up for 'our next offering' - a closed paying cohort for one course run, not an ongoing open community members return to indefinitely.

evidence.note: Listings are weekly evening sessions from 2026-03-10 to 2026-05-26 (the tail end of a 12-week arc), described as a guided journaling/creativity circle with no price or sign-up info in the event record itself.

Still Point Wellness's own page frames it as a structured, paid course ($525 plus supplies, payment plan available), 'limited to 10 students,' facilitated by two named instructors, with sign-up via a notification form for the next course offering - a business class, not a standing club.
Listed under Still Point's 'continuing education courses' catalog alongside other paid workshops, reinforcing this is a commercial course product rather than a self-organizing community.

A separate, unrelated outfit ('Artist's Way Asheville') also runs Artist's Way cohorts in town (4-10 people, 14 weeks), confirming the format citywide is a paid facilitated course rather than a single persistent membership group.
